raw_response:
This plot is very small, only a little piece of ground for my beans. I do not have money to buy fertilizer from the shop, and beans do not need it much anyway — my father never put fertilizer on beans. I keep some seed from last year's harvest, that is what I will plant again. I have some goat manure from the kraal, I will carry a few baskets to the plot before planting, and me and my wife will do all the work ourselves.
